title: Line and feeling
subject: Art & Design
unit: Spring 1: Abstract art, still life and analogous colour
source: Written for art/y8 lesson 3 (Line and feeling worksheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 3. Use only line (pencil) in each box to show the feeling. Then add colour to two boxes.

questions.q: Explain one colour choice. Start: 'I chose... because...'
questions.a: For example: 'I chose cool blue for calm because cool colours feel still.'
